name: Bill Schuette
summary:
William Duncan Schuette ( SHOO-tee; born October 13, 1953) is an American lawyer and politician who served as the 53rd attorney general of Michigan from 2011 to 2019. A member of the Republican Party, he was the party's nominee for U.S. Senate in 1990 and governor in 2018.
Schuette was first elected attorney general in 2010.
